description: This file defines the ConfigSettings view component for a SwiftUI-based macOS application. It manages the display and editing of configuration settings, including loading schemas, handling user interaction for section/subsection navigation, and form rendering for configuration parameters.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for configuring application settings via a schema-driven interface.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout, including sidebar and detail sections with loading and state handling.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures a section and subsection are selected based on current schema state.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts top-level configuration sections based on schema and UI hints.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts subsections within a section based on schema and hints.

methods.name: selectSection
methods.description: Sets a specific section as active and initializes its first subsection.

methods.name: resolveSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves the schema node, handling 'anyOf' and 'oneOf' variants.
